title: Best Practices for Evaluating Large Language Model Applications with llmeval: Niklas Nielsen
talk_summary: Niklas Nielsen demos llmeval, a CLI that structures prompts/tests in a Hydra config, runs each test N times (default 5) across multiple models, and reports pass/fail plus metrics. He also covers model-based grading (LLM-as-judge) and its biases, and a hybrid approach where a judge is modeled on prior human feedback.

takeaways.technique: Multi-sample pass-rate instead of single-run pass/fail
takeaways.what_they_do: Each test case runs 5 samples by default and the criterion is a majority/threshold pass rather than a single deterministic assertion, to absorb model fuzziness.
takeaways.evidence_quote: by default we do five samples so so we get like a better read on the stability of of each test

takeaways.technique: Prompt+test fixture directory with per-test metrics
takeaways.what_they_do: A versioned folder structure stores prompt templates, test inputs, expected outputs, and Python metric functions together, so prompt changes are evaluated against a fixed suite before rollout.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the metrics that we have wired up are in Python so they could be any logic

takeaways.technique: Cross-model eval matrix to justify model swaps
takeaways.what_they_do: The same test suite runs across Claude, GPT-4, and GPT-3.5 in one command, producing a per-model report so provider changes are evidence-based.
takeaways.evidence_quote: this ran across CLA gbt 4 and and gbt 3.5 once so we can go in and generate a report

takeaways.technique: LLM-as-judge with explicit rubric and known biases
takeaways.what_they_do: A larger model grades outputs on a 1-5 scale with stated criteria and reasoning, but the speaker warns judges favor their own model's output and are poor at fine-grained numeric scores.
takeaways.evidence_quote: they tend to prefer their own output then I'm very good at giving Point scores

takeaways.what_they_do: Instead of removing humans, they collect prior human review feedback and model a judge on it so AI suggestions mimic a specific reviewer's standards.
takeaways.evidence_quote: if you have all the feedback from John then we create an autog John that will start create generating feedback

takeaways.what_they_do: Tests strip leading whitespace and other model-specific artifacts before comparing, because models like Claude prepend spaces or add chatty explanations.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we had taken the Liberty to do is to strip any spaces that might be come from from the left
